notes.title: FUCK HITLER: Definitive Edition update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In response to your feedback, I have decided to release the final update for FUCK HITLER: Definitive Edition update. As the name suggests, this is the final state of the game, meaning the game will not receive any more updates, except for possible updates containing new languages. This update addresses the most common issues encountered during gameplay and enhances both gameplay and the interface. Specifically:

[h3]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]
From now on, all controls in the game are more intuitive. Mode selection is done by mouse/touchpad movement instead of using the mouse wheel (which, as I have heard many times, not everyone has). A hotbar has also been added to the main screen, informing the player of the current mode.

[h3]NEW BUILD MODE[/h3]
Now, during building, each block can be zoomed in or out from the player, block rotation has been improved, and deletion is done by holding the right mouse button (RMB) and clicking the left mouse button (LMB). Thanks to these changes, the entire building system is more enjoyable and intuitive. Additionally, I've added the option to change the color of the block to one of the 10 available colors.

[h3]PLAY MODE[/h3]
Animations in Play Mode have also been improved. The rifle is no longer statically attached to the character but moves with the player's movement. The same applies to the artwork. This simply makes everything look better.

[h3]LEADERBOARD[/h3]
Player rankings are now visible, and the score players achieve is assigned to the account, not, as in the older version of the game, to a specific save. Therefore, we can create many new game saves, and the score we achieve will always remain the same, eliminating the risk of accidental deletion.

[h3]WORKSHOP[/h3]
Players can now share their maps via the Steam Workshop. In the map selection menu, simply choose a specific map and then press the "Upload to Workshop" icon on the right side. It's that easy!

[h3]NEW LANGUAGES[/h3]
The game is now available in over 28 languages! As I mentioned at the beginning, it is possible to add additional languages in the future.

As you can see, there have been several improvements that, I hope, will make your gaming experience more enjoyable.

I would also like to take this opportunity to thank everyone for their involvement and the positive feedback of the game. In 1 year, the game has been added to the libraries of [b]over 1,400,000 players[/b], and for that, I am incredibly proud and grateful.

[h1]Thank you!!![/h1]

notes.title: Ultimate Ragdoll Game is available now!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I'm thrilled to share the exciting news that my latest game creation, Ultimate Ragdoll Game, is now available in early access! It's been a labor of love, and I can't wait for you to experience the thrill and excitement it offers.

Launching in early access allows us to involve you, the players, in shaping the final version of the game. Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable to us as we work together to refine the gameplay, add exciting features, and enhance the overall experience. Your involvement will help make Ultimate Ragdoll Game the best it can be!

Additionally, I'm excited to announce that Ultimate Ragdoll Game supports the Steam Workshop, giving you the opportunity to download and share your own custom characters and maps. Unleash your creativity and make the game truly unique to your vision.

Thank you for joining me on this incredible journey, and I look forward to hearing your thoughts and seeing what amazing creations you come up with in Ultimate Ragdoll Game!
